senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; צָוָה; cmp. צְוָואָה)heap of stones, mark, esp. the mark put up to indicate the neighborhood of an unclean place.
units: Erub. 54ᵇ מאי … צ׳ לישנא דסימנא הוא what evidence is there that this tsiyyun (Jer. XXXI, 20) means sign? Answ. ref. to Ez. XXXIX, 15.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1:14">Y. Shek. I, 46ᵃ</cite> <he>מיכן לצ׳</he> from here (Ez. l. c.) we have an evidence for the custom of marking sunken graves; <cite ref="Moed Katan 5a:13">M. Kat. 5ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 5b:16">Ib. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מעמידין צ׳ במקום וכ׳</he> we must not put up a mark on the very spot of uncleanness.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 52:5">Ex. R. s. 52</cite> (play on <cite ref="R00324"><he>צִיוֹן</he></cite>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 3:11">Cant. III, 11</cite>) <he>מה הצ׳ הזה נראה באצבע וכ׳</he> as a mark is seen (pointed at) with the finger, so is Israel (distinguishable by his features); a. e.—Pl. <he>צִיּוּנִים</he>, <he>צִיּוּנִין</he>. Erub. l. c. (ref. to Jer. l. c.) <he>עשו צ׳ לתורה</he> make marks (mnemonical notes) for the study of the Law, v. <cite ref="O00710"><he>סִימָן</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 315:5">Yalk. Jer. 315</cite>.—Denom. <cite ref="R00384"><he>צִיֵּן</he></cite>.
